title: Between-phonation perturbation variability did not improve frozen Oxford-to-Spain Parkinson prediction
abstract: Adding between-phonation SDs of log jitter RAP and local shimmer to eight mean perturbation measures worsened frozen Oxford-to-Spain Parkinson prediction: Brier loss 0.308540 to 0.330509, gain -0.021969, source-and-target-refit 95% interval [-0.083887, 0.016573]; AUROC 0.6000 to 0.5475. Stable incremental value was not established. Source has32 identifier groups despite31-person documentation; source identity and demographic/extraction differences limit inference.
